# FpsCounter

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** FpsCounter

## What it does

Shows the client's frame rate in the HUD.

Description basis: [source review](https://github.com/Pan4ur/ThunderHack-Recode/blob/49c76bcc5a5e4fbd12b06305c09f0c8fb76c510b/src/main/java/thunder/hack/features/hud/impl/FpsCounter.java).
